gate: Session duration changes after journal replay.

evidence.typeScriptContracts: packages/activity-domain/src/app-game.ts requires session and daily-rollup foreground + background duration to equal running duration, with tests covering invalid totals and evidence timestamp requirements.
evidence.rustSessionization: crates/agent-core/src/activity_store_app_game/app_game_sessionization.rs sorts replayed rows, derives running duration from observation timestamps, and derives background duration from running minus foreground duration.
evidence.rustSessionizationTests: crates/agent-core/src/activity_store_app_game/app_game_sessionization_tests.rs proves replay order reconstructs the same summary and daily rollups sum durations by day/classification.
evidence.journalReplayTests: crates/agent-core/src/activity_store_app_game/app_game_journal_sqlite_ingest_tests.rs proves encrypted journal replay projects app/game SQLite rows whose daily rollup durations become 60000ms, and duplicate runtime replay does not double-count duration.
